text: morning team. Q3 numbers, final, no more haggling: new business target for the quarter is EUR 2.15m across the four of you. Yusuf 640k, Anders 580k, Katharina 520k, Weronika 410k. renewals are tracked separately and are NOT part of this.
580 is a lot for a quarter where half of Norway is on holiday until 12 August
Norway is on holiday and Norwegians still need cold chains. it is 580.
do deals signed in Q3 but go-live in Q4 count?
yes, the signature date counts, not go-live. the CRM close date must equal the signature date, not the date you hope
<@U04RAF01> that has never been how it worked in Q1
it is how it works from today
pipeline call is on? monday 09:30 same link?
pipeline call is Mondays 09:30, 30 minutes, camera on. whoever has no activity on an opp for 21 days gets it flagged red in the CRM and I will ask about it in the call. nothing personal
marketing here. the Nordic Reefer Summit invite came, 15-17 October in Gothenburg. our stand would be EUR 4,900 for 6 sqm, early bird until 31 July. do we go or not
we go if Anders and Katharina both say they have at least 5 people to meet. otherwise no
i have 7
4. but 3 of them are the same Hamburg freight forwarder lol
ok 7 + 4. we go. Lotte book it, 4,900 is approved, I will sign the PO this week
booking now. you two pick the booth shirts, i'm not choosing the color again
Rybex signed!! 12 months Harbour, 30 tags. also they paid the first invoice 8 days early so they get the early-payment 1.2 % off, as written in their offer
good. referral ask please, 3 names
already promised on the phone, hehe

quick one: new lead from the Baltic Logistics Day, Stavanger Skalldyr AS. shellfish, they move about 18 reefers a week out of Stavanger. decision maker Ingrid Solvang (ops). they want a quote by 19 July

it was a Baltic event! but ok. passing it to you, here is the contact. you owe me a coffee
deal. i drive to Stavanger on 23 July
Koszalin Lody call booked Thursday 11 July 14:00, contact is Halina Dziurdziak (head of logistics). she said the magic words: we lose 3 pallets a month
call done. Halina: 14 reefers/week, summer peak 20. She wants to see the alarm for -21 live before signing. demo on 18 July
reminder, discount approvals: you ask in the channel with the customer name and the percentage, I answer with a thumb or a number. no thumb = no discount. I am not reading DMs about this
Hanseatic Fleisch wants a HAM-2 depot tour, they propose 2 Oct. is anyone from ops able to host
ask Dieter, Hamburg is his turf. if Dieter says no, Jarek's people can't
Dieter says yes, 2 Oct, 10:00 at Waltershof, 90 minutes. he'll even wear the vest
LinkedIn post about the 24-month renewal with Fruttoria got 4,200 impressions and 31 reactions in 24h. Ewelina approved the wording btw. best result of the year
she approved it with 3 changes. 3. i counted
Bornholm Røgeri A/S, smoked fish, 2 hubs + 40 tags, EUR 27,300 for 12 months. they want to sign on the 23rd, I'll be in Stavanger so Lotte can you send the DocuSign
sure, on the 23rd I send it at 08:00 and they sign before lunch, trust me
brochure reprint: 2,000 copies of the Tidewalk Fairway/Harbour brochure, EUR 1,260 from the printer in Gdańsk, ready 29 July. say if the pricing page needs a fix before that
the Harbour column has an old tag count. fix it, 60 tags not 50
fixed. proof is in the drive
Stavanger quote went out. EUR 41,800 for 12 months, 50 tags, 1 hub, Fairway plan. valid for 45 days
validity: from 1 October quotes are valid 30 days, not 45. for now 45 is fine
noted
Fruttoria asked for SSO again. product says Tidewalk v7 beta, 2025. I said we will see. wrong answer?
right answer. never promise a date from the product team in writing. never.
Bornholm signed 11:02, EUR 27,300. told you
and I am in the Stavanger rain thinking about you
visit done. Ingrid says they decide by 15 October. she needs the boxes tracked also at Rotterdam. we have RTM-3 so no problem. she asked for 99.9 % platform uptime in writing
nobody is writing 99.9 in a quote. the standard is what the contract says. send me her exact wording
Tallinn Kala OÜ lost, EUR 19,500. went to Polar Chain Eesti, local-language support and a tag price they can beat. I can't beat Estonian

lol no
Koszalin Lody S.A., ice cream maker, 14 reefers a week into Gdynia, wants an alarm for -21 not the standard one. can the alarm threshold be customised?
yes, per container profile, I did it for Fruttoria. ask Kamil's team for the how-to
Kamil says custom profile takes his people 2 working days to set up. ok
quarterly reminder. CRM rule: stage Proposal needs a quote number in the format Q-2024-xxxx, otherwise I move it back to Qualified. it is Monday, I know
August. 8 weeks left. pipeline coverage today is 2.3x on the remaining target, I want 3x by 31 August. so: more qualified opps, less scrolling
Lumikko is angry. a door-open alert on Saturday 3 Aug came 31 minutes late and they want money. who is writing to them
not you, not me. Benedikta writes, Sofia reviews. do not speak to Tuomas about money
understood. Tuomas rang me twice already though
Lietuvos Pienas UAB (dairy co-op, Kaunas): they want a pilot, 25 tags for 45 days. free?
free pilots up to 30 days, per the playbook. 45 needs my approval. 45 days with 25 tags is OK because they are a co-op with 9 dairies and a reference value. approved. 45 days, 25 tags, not more
thank you!!
competitor news: Meridian Chill NV opens a sales office in Gdańsk on 14 October, they're hiring 3 people. 3 people on LinkedIn right now
nobody panic. write down every account in Pomorskie where they could show up. I want the list by Friday
Friday 9 August?
yes. there is a reason Fridays exist
Haugesund Fiskemottak asked a 6 % discount, I have 4 % authority. Rafał?
no. they get 4 %, and if they insist the second hub is on us at 50 %. thumb on that.
pilot with Lietuvos Pienas starts Monday 12 August, 25 tags on their Kaunas to Gdynia lane, contact is Gediminas Rudys (QA). conversion decision on 24 September
change of rhythm. from this week the pipeline call is TUESDAY 08:45, not Monday. Mondays are a mess for ops and I want Katharina to have the Hamburg Monday morning
thank you!!
Lietuvos Pienas pilot, day 2: 25 tags online, 0 alarms. Gediminas is happy. he asked what the tag battery lasts
tell him years, not months, and do NOT quote a number, ask the product team
bad news. Hanseatic Fleisch's head of logistics Birgit says they will not decide before Q4, their Frostline contract runs to 31 December. so not Q3
ok. then your quota is too high. I am cutting Katharina from 520k to 470k. the team target becomes EUR 2.10m
THANK you. I'm buying schnitzel
the Hamburg depot tour for Hanseatic needs a list of names 5 days before. Birgit sent 6 names. one is a Wolfgang who is not a Wolfgang, it's a Wolfram
Wolfram it is

on it. but i need Sofia on the partner agreement

10 is a number I picked. 8 would also be ok :)

26th

app is back for me
the customer note is out. availability for August on our side is shown as 99.80 %, that is 90 minutes in 744 hours. do NOT volunteer it, do not lie about it. Sofia is reviewing the Nordkjøl clause

Q4 kickoff is Thursday 10 October at 09:00 in room Orka, Łużycka. Dieter and Priya will talk for 10 minutes each. I will talk for 20. there will be pizza

yes. the morning pizza is a tradition

September. pipeline coverage 2.9x. close but not 3. what is stuck

approved: Nordkjøl 8 % as of now. that's it. no more increase unless Priya says so

perfect
